name: Pathfinder
description: Finds a path through any level and exports a Mega Hack v9 macro

step.name: Decision step (ticks)
step.description: How often (in 240 TPS ticks) the bot may change input. Lower = more precise but slower.

budget.name: CPU time per frame (ms)
budget.description: How much time per frame is spent simulating. Higher = faster search, lower FPS.

max-checkpoints.name: Max checkpoints in memory
max-checkpoints.description: Older checkpoints are dropped and replayed from the start when needed.

dead-end-ticks.name: Dead end threshold (ticks)
dead-end-ticks.description: If the bot must go back more than this many ticks after dying, the spot is reported as a dead end.
